value.rationale: Arithmetic splitting of rational tangent-contact divisors is a geometrically natural moduli invariant not determined by generic class counts, 2-rank or the number of rational points. The complete 11-stratum table and unique four-flex class distinguish genuine geometries and furnish an exact sharp extremum on the full F2 smooth genus-three plane-quartic locus.
